items.title: Understanding GEO: How to Optimise Content in the New AI Era and Compete Across Google and LLMs - FIPP 2026 - Clara Soteras
items.summary: This workshop was delivered at the FIPP World Media Congress 2026 in Madrid on 14 October 2026, exploring the evolution of SEO towards Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) and the new principles, signals and content strategies that media organisations need to consider to maintain and strengthen their visibility in an increasingly AI-driven search ecosystem.The session examined how media organisations can move beyond generating traffic and clicks to focus on building authority, strengthening editorial brands and ensuring that the expertise, experience and specialist knowledge of journalists and publishers are recognised and surfaced by search engines and AI systems.Participants were provided with clear, actionable guidelines to adapt their content strategies to the changing search landscape, alongside a practical exercise to help them understand and apply these principles in their own work. Key topics included the growing importance of new content formats, such as video, the role of social signals, and how to interpret evolving algorithms and understand what AI-driven platforms are looking for.The workshop also explored strategies to increase the likelihood of editorial content being surfaced in Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and other LLM-based experiences, helping publishers position their publications and journalism as authoritative, relevant and trustworthy sources for AI-generated answers.
